extracted.name: Limoncello Spritz
extracted.description: This limoncello spritz recipe is easy to make with prosecco, limoncello liqueur, and club soda. Fizzy and bright, this classic Italian cocktail is so refreshing on a summer day!
instruction_lines: Fill a wine glass with ice.
Pour in the Prosecco, followed by the limoncello and club soda. Stir gently, then garnish with mint and lemon wheels and serve.
